snippet.title: The Lone Sword - Official Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
The Lone Sword is a narrative platformer where YOU are the weapon. As a living Sword, embark on a journey to find your Maker. Explore the Castle, solve physics puzzles, master the blade in aerial swordfight, and reflect on your purpose in this emotionally rich adventure. The Lone Sword will be available on PC on April 21, 2026. A demo is out now on Steam.

#TheLoneSword #Gaming #IGN
